course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A machine learning inference server processes prediction requests. The server can handle an average of 20 predictions per hour (processing times are exponentially distributed). On average, 30 prediction requests per hour arrive at the server (interarrival times are exponentially distributed). Due to memory limitations, the maximum capacity of the server is 30 predictions (including the one being processed). Answer the followings:
i) On average, how many prediction requests successfully enter the system each hour?
ii) What is the probability that the inference server is busy processing a request?
